cues: Its gently curved, elongated body is wrapped in a peel that separates easily from the soft flesh.
As it ripens, the green exterior turns yellow, while small brown freckles often appear across the peel.
The short stem end joins several similarly shaped pieces into a compact hand.
Its pale, creamy interior has a smooth texture and usually contains no large, hard seeds.
A slight bruise quickly darkens the delicate skin and can soften the flesh beneath.
The long, narrow shape tapers toward a dark tip opposite its short, cut stem.
Peeling back its flexible yellow covering reveals flesh that breaks easily into soft sections.
When unripe, its flesh is firmer and starchier, becoming sweeter and softer as the peel yellows.
